description: Lay icon images (PNG or .mcpx) into grid-aligned bitmap font atlases and build the font definition (one bitmap provider per height/ascent group, plus optional space and reference providers) and the icon-to-character table. Each icon may set its own height and ascent; icons that share a pair share one atlas, and a spec with several pairs writes one atlas per pair. Icons are sorted by name and code points are allocated deterministically, so shuffled input produces byte-identical artifacts. Every chars row is padded to the column count with U+0000, ascent may be negative, and space advances are signed. A duplicate code point, an ascent above its height, or an over-tall icon is refused before anything is written.

atlasDirPath.description: Explicit directory receiving one atlas .png per height/ascent group, each named from its texture location. Use instead of atlasPath when the spec mixes geometries.

atlasPath.description: Explicit atlas .png output path for a spec with one height/ascent group. When omitted the PNG bytes embed as pngBase64.

force.description: Replace existing output files as a whole.

outputPath.description: Explicit font definition .json output path. When omitted the definition text returns in the result and nothing is written.

spec.description: Inline font spec object with the same fields as the document (formatVersion, namespace, id, icons at least; height and ascent are top-level defaults or per-icon values). Exactly one of specPath and spec.

specPath.description: Font spec JSON path; a relative icon path inside it resolves against the spec directory. Exactly one of specPath and spec.

tablePath.description: Explicit icon table .json output path. When omitted the table text returns in the result.

name: font_asset
